snippet.title: Fragmentary Order | Gameplay First look
snippet.description:
Fragmentary Order is a next-generation first person tactical combat simulator combining predicting-the-future hard sci-fi, systemic gameplay, and high-stakes survival in a world where warfare has become a controlled, remote-driven economy.
Learn more: https://fragmentaryorder.com
